partc.title: Official letter (10 marks, about 150 words).
partc.prompt: You are a Junior Technician in the CSE Department computer lab. Twice this month, sudden power cuts have damaged lab computers. Write an official letter to the Head of the Department requesting the purchase of 10 UPS units.
partc.guide: Sender’s designation and department; date; “To, The Head, Department of CSE”; a one-line subject (“Request for purchase of 10 UPS units for the computer lab”); salutation; body in three short paragraphs (the problem with dates, the request with quantity, the benefit); “Yours faithfully”; name and designation. Formal tone, no contractions.

partc.title: Incident report (10 marks, about 200 words).
partc.prompt: On a Saturday night the air conditioning in the department server room failed. The room overheated and two servers shut down, so the department website and file server were unavailable until Sunday morning. Write an incident report covering what happened, the impact, the action taken, and how to prevent it in future.
partc.guide: Title; date, time and location; reported by; then headed sections: Summary, Timeline, Impact (which services, how long), Cause, Action taken, Preventive measures (temperature alarm, backup cooling, automatic alerts, a weekend on-call contact). Past tense, facts only, no blame.

partc_note: **Self-marking out of 10 each:** format 3, content 4, language 3.
